chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Ali ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
He said: 'The most intense of the people in punishment on the Day of Resurrection will be a man who caused his seed to fall into a womb which was prohibited unto him.'

key_terms.أَشَدَّ النَّاسِ عَذَاباً: most intense of the people in punishment

ai.seo_question: Who receives the harshest punishment on the Day of Judgment according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to highlight the gravity of *zina* (adultery) or prohibited union, emphasizing that the act of establishing lineage (*iqrar al-nutfah*) in a forbidden womb incurs the severest eschatological penalty. This underscores the Shia jurisprudential focus on the sanctity of marital boundaries and the spiritual weight of illicit procreation.
